SELECT r.RECIPE_NO , r.RECIPE_TITLE , r.RECIPE_MAIN_IMG , r.RECIPES_IMG_PATH , m.MEMBER_NAME , r.CREATE_DATE , r.RECIPE_TYPE , r.COOKING_METHOD , r.CALORIE , r.MAIN_MATERIAL , r.VIEW_COUNT FROM RECIPES r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO
ORDER BY r.VIEW_COUNT DESC , r.CREATE_DATE DESC , r.RECIPE_NO DESC
ORDER BY r.CREATE_DATE DESC , r.RECIPE_NO DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT r.RECIPE_NO , r.RECIPE_TITLE , r.RECIPE_MAIN_IMG , r.RECIPES_IMG_PATH , m.MEMBER_NAME , r.CREATE_DATE , r.RECIPE_TYPE , r.COOKING_METHOD , r.CALORIE , r.MAIN_MATERIAL , r.VIEW_COUNT FROM RECIPES r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO WHERE r.DEL_YN = 'N' AND r.CALORIE IS NOT NULL AND r.RECIPE_NO NOT IN ( SELECT mat.RECIPE_NO FROM MATERIAL mat JOIN MEMBER_ALLERGY ma ON mat.MATERIAL_NAME LIKE '%' || ma.MATERIAL_NAME || '%' WHERE ma.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ) ORDER BY ABS(r.CALORIE - #{perMeal}) ASC , r.VIEW_COUNT DESC , r.CREATE_DATE ASC , r.RECIPE_NO ASC FETCH FIRST #{count} ROWS ONLY

SELECT r.RECIPE_NO , r.MEMBER_NO , r.RECIPE_TITLE , r.RECIPE_INFO , r.RECIPE_MAIN_IMG , r.RECIPES_IMG_PATH , m.MEMBER_NAME , r.CREATE_DATE , r.COOKING_METHOD , r.RECIPE_TYPE , r.CALORIE , r.CARBOHYDRATE , r.PROTEIN , r.FAT , r.SODIUM , r.MAIN_MATERIAL , r.VIEW_COUNT , 0 AS IS_BOOKMARKED FROM RECIPES r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO WHERE r.RECIPE_NO = #{recipeNo} AND r.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE RECIPES SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1 WHERE RECIPE_NO = #{recipeNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
